implementation: engine/rust/question_selection.rs select; seen_before_task; candidates sorted/deduplicated by entity id, choose band then uniform(8) within it
weighted_behavior: All staged records moderate. With positive moderate weight, every fresh staged record is eligible with equal probability. Zero moderate weight excludes the whole rated cohort; no unweighted fallback to this cohort. Unconfigured policy returns lowest entity ID.
history_behavior: seen_before_task and current-prefix exclusion remove previously reserved items. Perfect batch numeric-rank cue and per-profile position cue remain perfect on every nonempty subset.
limitations: No concrete learner, policy weights, task history or eventual staged entity IDs supplied; no claim of exact future chosen question. Current bank contains only source originals; generated-batch analysis is conditional on those records entering an eligible pool.

rejection_and_resampling: generate selects a source profile and bounded translation directly; no validity rejection/resampling. batch enumerates 46 canonical unique tasks with seed=0 for each profile/translation, shuffles task order, selects prefix; catalog fixed option permutation per profile. This is distinct from fresh generate seeds.
ui_stage: Actual UI choiceOrder reorders options; raw position predictor neutralized. Numeric-rank and label strategies are invariant under this stage.
